notes.backend: rt_core is the only execution backend. Approved digests and pair binding are required before startup; retired selections are refused.
notes.rt_core: Unverified deployment template: replace every REPLACE value and pair_revision with the approved binding before acquire. socket is the public control endpoint; controller names this daemon; pair_id and pair_revision bind the approved pair; machine_sha256, deployment_sha256 and configuration_sha256 pin the artifacts; expected_backend pins Describe; home_policy is home or restore_anchor; status_subject is the NATS execution status destination; control_timeout_ms is the unverified 10000 ms receipt and observation bound.
